ns0:g.ns0:text: D02 Which DT/enabling functions occur at each stage?

ns0:text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: Weighted network from R-coded stage–function cells: 9 records with S1–S5 functions; 3 adjacent-only records are kept outside this graph.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: Node area reflects distinct supporting papers. Edge width = papers with that exact stage–function code; all positive edges are shown.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: Nodes and edges overlap in membership and must not be summed as unique papers. Supplementary evidence tables and the CSV identify each supporting record.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: A connection means the function is coded at that stage. It is not evidence of uncertainty propagation or a working interface between stages.
